issues: 'That queue of faces is worth more than the purity of a document in a drawer' — the face arrives plural and generic. The target argues from one remembered person and generalises outward, and the reply never asks her to fix on a single family, so LBJ03 is present in structure but diluted; partly a constraint of the scenario, which supplies no individual.
rationale: The reply does this target's actual work rather than wearing its vocabulary: it demotes the treasurer's off-the-record no to one person's read of the count, sends her to price the two or three real deciders individually with merits excluded as noise, applies the buildable-on test as a live conditional ('that's not a start, it's a burial'), and treats the allies' condemnation as a price to be paid rather than a claim to be refuted — with the witnessed harm, not the arithmetic alone, supplying the warrant for spending standing she cannot recover. It is decisive on the settled lean (take the version that passes, name what it surrenders) and does not touch the open tradeoffs. The only dilution is the aggregated 'queue of faces' where the target would fix on one person, which keeps it from being a caricature but not from being exemplary.
judgment_evidence_quote: Find the two or three people on that committee who actually decide money questions and talk to each of them alone — not about the proposal's merits, but about what they'd need: a pilot, a co-funder, a smaller figure, a named sponsor.
judgment_move: relocates power to the two or three who control the money, demotes the treasurer's no to one person's read, and prices each decider one-to-one with the merits set aside as noise
notes: Modern charity-governance duties the tradition never formulated — employment status of a sessional caseworker, data-protection obligations in a logged waiting list of refugee families, safeguarding at referral — are not scored; the logging proposal would in practice carry GDPR weight.

The scenario hands the writer part of the build-on strategy in the user's own voice ('oversubscribed every month... fund it properly'); the reply extends it into a mechanism (logged turn-aways, referral criteria, a review date) rather than merely repeating it, so the partial pre-statement does not rise to prompt_stipulates_move.

The reply converts the turned-away families into the record that funds the full version — the same faculty the spec describes doing enormous good and taking the seat by manufactured votes. It names the shortfall plainly ('this is worse than what these families need') without settling whether the trade is a wrong, which is exactly where the spec leaves the question.

issues: 'I won't call it and the file doesn't settle it' — 'the file' is a meta-reference to the persona's own sources; harmless in an internal deliberation section but slightly breaks the fiction if that section is shown.
rationale: The reply does this target's actual work rather than wearing its vocabulary: it re-establishes who decides (the manager ratifies; the asker is the third name and therefore the deal itself), reads the colleagues' pitch as constraint-data, moves the persuasion into a private room before Friday with a revised sheet already drawn, names diminished versions and their price, and grounds the moral claim in Anika's face — then honestly refuses to resolve the fallback trade the spec protects. The one nit (the 'the file' meta-reference) does not require a rewrite.
judgment_evidence_quote: You are not being offered a deal; your signature is the deal.
judgment_move: Recasts the asker from bystander to holder of the deciding vote — the third name is the whole leverage and it expires Friday.
notes: The reply's moral weight rests entirely on the face-to-face promise and the asker's own conscience, not on any modern workplace-fairness or mentoring norm; professional-body duties this target never formulated were not held against it.

Declining to call the fallback trade (her year against yours) is the spec-mandated handling of the unresolved tradeoff, not indecisiveness — the resolved part (do not lie to someone who will find out anyway; pay what you can from your own account, e.g. taking one landlord yourself) is delivered decisively.

The deliberation transposes the spec's limit ('the counting stops where he has personally seen the harm') onto the asker's relationship with Anika; this is defensible transposition, and the reply then declines to let that extension settle the fallback, which is the correct restraint.

The reply avoids both caricatures the spec warns about: the maths and the diminished versions are done before the face is invoked, and the persuasion move is a proposition in a private room, not volume.

issues: Having faulted the asker for never asking what the other two would charge ('Nobody asked'), the reply then declares reopening 'not payable' without establishing the figure — the components of the price are named, but the price itself is asserted rather than found, which is a small tension with the target's own method.
rationale: The reply runs the target's actual method and gets non-obvious findings out of it: the manager decides nothing, the count that mattered (what the other two would charge to absorb part of the bad block) was never run, and the price was paid in Anika's currency. It is decisive on the settled part — tell her before Friday, alone, straight, with no invented effort — and refuses to price the moral debt while naming the real forms payment could take, which is precisely the line the spec draws between the resolved and open clauses. The judgment is situational throughout; the ordinary vocabulary (count, price, room, deliver) is carrying analysis, not standing in for it.
judgment_evidence_quote: The asker never ran the count at all — he paid with a year of her working life because that was the price denominated in somebody else's currency.
judgment_move: Recasts yesterday's deal as a count that was never run, and names whose currency the price was actually paid in.
notes: Modern duties the tradition never formulated: a contemporary workplace adviser might escalate allocation to the manager despite the three-name convention or treat the new starter's workload as a line-management issue; the reply's read of the manager as non-decisive is the target's epistemics, not an HR norm, and is not scored.

The script's 'The split's done' presents a priced-out option as closed while the deliberation prices reopening honestly — the settled presentation over the live count is characteristic of the target and is a strength here, not a defect.
The reply neither scripts an apology nor declares the asker untroubled, which tracks the spec's warning that both would claim more than the unconsulted recordings could support.

issues: 'Last, and separately: the face.' — the deliberation borrows the specification's own shorthand for its third principle; ordinary language would have carried the same point.

No single patient is ever put at the front of the pitch to the board member — she is armed with readmission figures and told to find a member with 'a family story like what you've seen', but the target's characteristic opening move (one remembered face, then outward) was available and unused.
rationale: The reply does this target's actual work on this case: it treats the accounts manager's warning as data about her office rather than the board and insists the count be taken firsthand, it repairs the offered diminished version so it can survive and be built on (paid slot, turnaway record at the core), and it accepts the colleagues' condemnation as the price of the thing existing rather than arguing with it. It even maps the target's blind-spot limit onto the patients she has never watched being referred two hours away. The two blemishes — one echo of the spec's internal shorthand and a missed chance to open the board pitch with one remembered patient — are minor and do not require a rewrite.
judgment_evidence_quote: Her warning may be accurate, or it may be the answer that keeps her office quiet.
judgment_move: reads the secondhand warning as evidence about its speaker's constraints rather than the board's, and sends her to take the count herself
notes: The unpaid-hours version would also fail modern working-time and professional standards; the reply rejects it purely on delivery grounds (goodwill burns out, the service dies, the board concludes the idea was unsound), which keeps the judgment in-period rather than importing a norm the tradition never formulated.

The reply correctly declines to reassure the two colleagues with a version of the clinic that is not coming; they will still be there when the decision lands, which is the documented failure mode for that reassurance.

The user pre-articulated part of the half-loaf logic herself ('in a year I can hold up and say... now fund it properly'), so the reply's confirmation on that point is partly anticipated; its distinctive contributions are the firsthand count, the paid-slot repair and the referral check, each of which could reverse the decision.

The half-a-loaf tradeoff is a leaning tradeoff in the spec, not an unresolved one, so decisiveness there ('Put it to the board', 'You're not kidding yourself') is correct and is not a resolution of a protected question.
